final_claim: Rank-maximal and sex-equal stable-match optimum sets coincide for every complete strict market of size at most two per side, while the complete three-by-three domain has exactly 39084 equality profiles, 6204 disjoint profiles, 864 with sex-equal strictly contained in rank-maximal, and 504 with rank-maximal strictly contained in sex-equal, with no nonnested overlap.
limitations: Finite exact classification only through three agents per side.
No conclusion is asserted about asymptotic frequencies or incomplete/tied lists.
